name: Witch Doctor Dark Effigy makes Bad Juju and Hexfire strike exactly 2 additional enemies
contract: Dark Effigy 707331: 'Your Bad Juju and Hexfire now strike 2 additional nearby enemies.' Its Effect[0] is
aura 107 SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS +3 on Hexfire (mask word 1 262144) and Bad Juju (word 2 2), applied in
3 targets, the tooltip's primary and 2 more. Before the fix the script (AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:
133-144) added up to 2 more from Nearby(primary, 10), and Hexfire (EffectChainTarget 1) chained to 1 + 3 =
4 targets. The fix removes the script block and gives the Hexfire ranks EffectChainTarget 0 (one target
alone either way: a count of 1 is not above 1, Spell.cpp:1927).
Distances: a 10 yd check between two dummies passes up to 12.55 yd between centres (IsWithinDist adds
both combat reaches, 1.275 each for creature 36, model 367). Layout along +x from the doctor: near 1 yd,
primary 10, chain1 14, chain2 24.5, chain3 27.5. The chain takes the closest remaining dummy within
12.55 yd of the previous one (SearchChainTargets): primary, chain1 (4 yd; near is 9 yd), chain2 (10.5 yd
from chain1; near is 13), then chain3 (3 yd from chain2). The near dummy is 9 yd from the primary, inside
the script's Nearby(primary, 10); chain2 (14.5 yd), chain3 (17.5) are outside it. Before the fix the
script's picks are chain1 (already a target) and near, so near is struck by both spells on every run; with
only the script block removed Hexfire still chains to chain3. After the fix both spells strike the primary,
chain1 and chain2, and neither near nor chain3.
Control arm: the same casts before Dark Effigy is learned strike the primary only.
Live logs (2026-08-15) show Bad Juju striking at most 3 enemies per cast, as the tooltip states.
